###  checking preprocessed files
```{r}
# open the part 2 preprocessed file
inputs_p2 <- nc_open("wbgt_inputs_complete/wbgt_inputs_2026_01.nc") 

names(inputs_p2$var)
dim(ncvar_get(inputs_p2, "fdir_frac")) # R shows dimensions as longitude x latitude x times
ncatt_get(inputs_p2, "valid_time", "units")
```

```{r}
shp <- vect("ca_grid/ERA5_Land_grid_CAfull.shp")

r <- rast("wbgt_inputs_complete/wbgt_inputs_2026_01.nc", subds = "ssrd_W")
time_raw <- ncvar_get(inputs_p2, "valid_time")
time_vals <- as.POSIXct(time_raw, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")
time(r) <- time_vals
t_index <- which(time_vals == as.POSIXct("2026-01-01 18:00", tz="UTC"))
r_slice <- r[[t_index]]
r_crop <- crop(r_slice, shp)
r_mask <- mask(r_crop, shp)
plot(r_mask)
title(main = "ssrd_W at 2026-01-01 18:00 UTC (CA cropped)", line = 3)
```

###  checking WBGT files
```{r}
# open the wbgt 2026-01 file
wbgt <- nc_open("wbgt/wbgt_2026_01.nc") 

names(wbgt$var)
dim(ncvar_get(wbgt, "wbgt")) # R shows dimensions as longitude x latitude x times
ncatt_get(wbgt, "valid_time", "units")

summary(ncvar_get(wbgt, "wbgt"))

### subset Jan 1 from 2025 wbgt
wbgt_2025_01 <- nc_open("wbgt_2025_01.nc")
time_raw_2025 <- ncvar_get(wbgt_2025_01, "valid_time")
time_units_2025 <- ncatt_get(wbgt_2025_01, "valid_time", "units")$value
time_vals_2025 <- as.POSIXct(time_raw_2025, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")
idx_2025_jan1 <- which(as.Date(time_vals_2025, tz = "UTC") == as.Date("2025-01-01"))

wbgt_2025_all <- ncvar_get(wbgt_2025_01, "wbgt")
wbgt_2026_all <- ncvar_get(wbgt, "wbgt")
wbgt_2025_jan1 <- wbgt_2025_all[, , idx_2025_jan1]
wbgt_2026_jan1 <- wbgt_2026_all[, , 1:24]

dim(wbgt_2025_jan1)
dim(wbgt_2026_jan1)

### compare values
summary(as.vector(wbgt_2025_jan1))
summary(as.vector(wbgt_2026_jan1))

```

```{r}
shp <- vect("ca_grid/ERA5_Land_grid_CAfull.shp")
wbgt <- rast("wbgt/wbgt_2026_01.nc", subds = "wbgt")
wbgt_ca <- crop(wbgt, shp)
wbgt_ca <- mask(wbgt_ca, shp)

vals <- values(wbgt_ca, mat = TRUE)
vals <- as.vector(vals)
summary(vals)
```


```{r}
# crop to California shape and plot

shp <- vect("ca_grid/ERA5_Land_grid_CAfull.shp")
wbgt <- nc_open("wbgt/wbgt_2026_01.nc") 

time_raw <- ncvar_get(wbgt, "valid_time")
time_units <- ncatt_get(wbgt, "valid_time", "units")$value
time_vals <- as.POSIXct(time_raw, origin="1970-01-01", tz="UTC")

r <- rast("wbgt/wbgt_2026_01.nc", subds = "wbgt")
time_raw <- ncvar_get(wbgt, "valid_time")
time_vals <- as.POSIXct(time_raw, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")
time(r) <- time_vals
t_index <- which(time_vals == as.POSIXct("2026-01-01 18:00", tz="UTC"))
r_slice <- r[[t_index]]
r_crop <- crop(r_slice, shp)
r_mask <- mask(r_crop, shp)
plot(r_mask)
title(main = "wbgt at 2026-01-01 18:00 UTC", line=3)

nc_close(wbgt)
```

```{r}
# California shape
shp <- vect("ca_grid/ERA5_Land_grid_CAfull.shp")


# =========================
# 2025: January 1, 18:00 UTC
# =========================

wbgt_2025 <- nc_open("wbgt_2025_01.nc")

time_raw_2025 <- ncvar_get(wbgt_2025, "valid_time")
time_vals_2025 <- as.POSIXct(
  time_raw_2025,
  origin = "1970-01-01",
  tz = "UTC"
)

r_2025 <- rast(
  "wbgt_2025_01.nc",
  subds = "wbgt"
)

time(r_2025) <- time_vals_2025

t_index_2025 <- which(
  time_vals_2025 == as.POSIXct("2025-01-01 18:00", tz = "UTC")
)

r_2025_slice <- r_2025[[t_index_2025]]
r_2025_crop <- crop(r_2025_slice, shp)
r_2025_mask <- mask(r_2025_crop, shp)

nc_close(wbgt_2025)


# =========================
# 2026: January 1, 18:00 UTC
# =========================

wbgt_2026 <- nc_open("wbgt/wbgt_2026_01.nc")

time_raw_2026 <- ncvar_get(wbgt_2026, "valid_time")
time_vals_2026 <- as.POSIXct(
  time_raw_2026,
  origin = "1970-01-01",
  tz = "UTC"
)

r_2026 <- rast(
  "wbgt/wbgt_2026_01.nc",
  subds = "wbgt"
)

time(r_2026) <- time_vals_2026

t_index_2026 <- which(
  time_vals_2026 == as.POSIXct("2026-01-01 18:00", tz = "UTC")
)

r_2026_slice <- r_2026[[t_index_2026]]
r_2026_crop <- crop(r_2026_slice, shp)
r_2026_mask <- mask(r_2026_crop, shp)

nc_close(wbgt_2026)


# =========================
# SAME COLOR SCALE
# =========================

# Use the combined range from both years
common_min <- min(
  min(values(r_2025_mask), na.rm = TRUE),
  min(values(r_2026_mask), na.rm = TRUE)
)

common_max <- max(
  max(values(r_2025_mask), na.rm = TRUE),
  max(values(r_2026_mask), na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Plot side-by-side using identical color limits
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(
  r_2025_mask,
  zlim = c(common_min, common_max),
  main = "WBGT\nJanuary 1, 2025 18:00 UTC"
)

plot(
  r_2026_mask,
  zlim = c(common_min, common_max),
  main = "WBGT\nJanuary 1, 2026 18:00 UTC"
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
